children: Chinese investment firm Legend's 31% stake in the PC maker has more than tripled to $17 bln this year. Yet the $7 bln group trades at a 75% discount to net asset value. Exiting non-core stakes is sensible, but Tencent-backer Prosus shows how hard it will be to fix its valuation.
Full view will be published shortly.

Legend Holdings is working with Goldman Sachs to sell its 90 per cent stake in Banque Internationale à Luxembourg. Initial bids are due around the end of this month and could value the group at roughly €2.5bn ($2.8 billion) or more, according to people familiar with the matter, Financial Times reported on September 20.
Legend Holdings owns a 31.4% stake in computer-to-AI firm Lenovo. The stake is worth over $17 billion after a tripling in share price this year.
